title: Worms
overview:
Super Fun. Super Addictive.

The strategic active simulation "WORMS"! A completely new game that took Europe and America by storm has arrived!! In this age when character games and series games are all the rage, we dare to make an old-fashioned proposal: "If it's fun, isn't that enough?!"

Cute, but outstanding firepower!? Underestimate them because they're tiny and you'll be in for a world of hurt!

Here comes a game where you "think strategically," using every kind of weapon and even taking wind direction and wind strength into account to score high points!!

10 kinds of fields, including unusual ones like sweets and Mars. And the terrain variations number over 4 billion!

超おもしろい。超ハマる。

戦略アクティブシミュレーション『WORMS』!欧米を席巻した、全く新しいゲームがやってきた!!キャラクターものやシリーズもの全盛の今、敢えて時代遅れの提案をさせて頂きたい。「おもしろければ、いいじゃありませんか!」

かわいいけど威力は抜群!?ちいちゃいからとナメてかかると痛いメみるぞ!

高得点を得るため、あらゆる武器を駆使し、風向きや風圧まで考えにいれた「戦略を考える」ゲームの登場だ!!

お菓子や火星などの変わったフィールドを含め10種類。なんと、地形のバリエーションは40億以上!
